hypothesis: Does covariate-shift reweighting of mature top-candidate calibration using recent unlabeled observable contexts improve causal forecasting and capital outcomes? v22 nearest-state kernel and v29 changepoint weighting already failed; this tests balanced source/target density odds, not the first state-aware model.
inputs: Exact v79 top calibration parents/weights; v78 as-issued gap_blend probabilities, top direction, class payoffs and 18-field readiness. Sign-align13 price fields with original top and add SOXS indicator. No added market data. Source top calibration labels remain fully mature14day chronological prefix.
targets: Daily00ET. recent=last20 consecutive prior official sessions; lagged=prior20 (-40:-20). All required clocks must have full original feature readiness and source as-issued gap_blend ready. Missing any date makes variant unready; no backwards gap fill. Target contexts contain dates/features/as-issued top only, never outcome/release fields. Each target date weight1/20 divided among clocks. Source/target overlaps recorded, not independent samples.

Minimize weighted logloss+5||beta||^2. ExactHessian dampedNewton80,gradient target1e-9,required1e-7,Armijo50 with64eps rounding tolerance only if gradient halves. Ratio exp(logit) clipped[0.2,5]. No fitted feature map, no outcome-based domain fitting.

decision: Preserve v78 original top and require original source-eligible plus new expected netlog>1e-12; never rerank or promote source CASH. verification: Independent official date windows, source-selected mature members, sign coordinates, weighted domain standardization, convex gradients, clipped ratios, totalmass/dateESS, class gradients, action direction and ten capitalbooks/170 statistics; four parent books byte-identical. Independent L-BFGS anchors and causal/unit tests before source freeze.
limitations: Density ratio relies on approximate overlap and stable conditional outcomes; neither is proved in markets. Clipping/penalty bias ratios.20recentdates and overlapping source are small, dependent observations. No guarantee of future nonnegative months; not a money-flow observation.
